BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when DAP enables AP1 for CPU1 (CM33) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_DSP
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when DAP enables AP3 for DSP (CoolFlux) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: EFUSE_ATTACK_DETECT
BitField.description: OTPC can output attack_detect signal when it detects attack when load shadow registers. The output will be cleared by reset. ELS_AS_FLAG is reset by PoR, so the status can be recorded.

BitField.name: FLAG_LVD_CORE_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD_CORE LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_WDT0_RESET_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 0 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

BitField.name: FLAG_CWDT0_RESET_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 0 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

BitField.name: FLAG_WDT0_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 0 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_CWDT0_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 0 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_QK_ERROR
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when QK_ERROR is flagged from QK PUF block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_ELS_GLITCH_DETECTED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when GDET error is flagged. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_ANA_GLITCH_DETECTED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when ANALOG GDET error is flagged in SYSCON block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_TAMPER_EVENT_DETECTED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when tamper event is flagged from TDET. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR or by PMC reset event, if tamper detection event is cleared by software.

BitField.name: FLAG_FLASH_ECC_INVALID
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when FLASH controller indicates ECC error. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_SEC_VIOL_IRQ_OCURRED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when security violation is indicated from FLASH sub-system or AHB bus matrix.

BitField.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_C_ACC_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure code transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_D_ACC_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure data transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_LVD_VSYS_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD_SYS LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_LVD_VDDIO_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_WDT1_RESET_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 1 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

BitField.name: FLAG_CWDT1_RESET_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 1 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

BitField.name: FLAG_WDT1_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 1 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_CWDT1_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 1 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_TEMPTAMPER_DET_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when temperature temper IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_VOLTAMPER_DET_IRQ_OCCURED

BitField.name: FLAG_LHTTAMPER_DET_IRQ_OCCURED

BitField.name: FLAG_CLKTAMPER_DET_IRQ_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when clock temper IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

BitField.name: FLAG_HVD_CORE_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when HVD from VDD_CORE power domain is triggered.

BitField.name: FLAG_HVD_VSYS_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when HVD from VDD_SYS power domain is triggered

BitField.name: FLAG_HVD_VDDIO_OCCURED
BitField.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when HVD from VDD power domain is triggered

BitField.name: SEL_PMATCH
BitField.description: Specifies whether the pin interrupts are controlled by the pin interrupt function or by the pattern-match function. If this value is 0b, interrupts are driven in response to the standard pin interrupt function. If this value is 1b, interrupts are driven in response to pattern matches.

BitField.name: PROD_ENDPTS5

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Timeout disabled, if timeout is configured

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Disable open-drain stop. ODSTOP must be disabled when sending an HDR exit pattern.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Enable open-drain stop. STOP is emitted at open-drain speeds even for I3C messages. In legacy devices, this feature can ensure that the legacy devices see the STOP.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: ODHPP disabled. Open-Drain SCL High half-clock period is the same as the Open-Drain Low SCL half-period.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: ODHPP enabled. Open-Drain High SCL half-lock period is one PPBAUD count for I3C messages. This setting is faster (and works for I3C devices). Any legacy I2C devices on the bus will not see the SCL High at all (less than the spike filter period).

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Target ignores the I2C or I3C bus

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Target can operate on the I2C or I3C bus

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Always NACK enable. The target rejects all requests to it, except for a Common Command Code (CCC) broadcast. NACK = 1 should be used with caution, because the controller may decide that the target is missing, if NACK is overused.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Match START or STOP enable. START and STOP sticky SSTATUS bits only become 1 when SSTATUS[MATCHED] is 1. This setting allows START and STOP to be used to detect the end of a message to/from this target.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Ignore TE0/TE1 errors. Target does not detect TE0 or TE1 errors, so it does not lock up waiting on an Exit Pattern. This setting should only be used when the bus does not use HDR mode.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: SIDPARTNO[PARTNO] is a part number and an instance.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Enables wait to ensure the bus is not in HDR mode.

Enum.name: STOPPED
Enum.description: I3C module is in a STOP condition.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: Bus target not listening or responding.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: This bus target is listening to the bus traffic or responding.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: No CCC message is being handled.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: A CCC message is being handled automatically.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: REQ in process is not an SDR read from this target.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: The REQ in process is an SDR read from this target, or an In-Band Interrupt (IBI) is being pushed out.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: REQ in process is not SDR write data from the controller.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: REQ in process is SDR write data from the controller to this bus target (or all I3C targets), but not in ENTDAA mode.

Enum.name: IN_ENTDAA
Enum.description: I3C bus is in Enter Dynamic Address Assignment (ENTDAA) mode, regardless of whether this bus target has a Dynamic Address or not.

Enum.name: NOT_IN_HDR_DDR
Enum.description: I3C bus not in HDR-DDR mode

Enum.name: IN_HDR_DDR
Enum.description: The I3C bus is in HDR-DDR mode , regardless of whether HDR mode is supported by this module or not, and regardless of whether the message is to this module or to some other module.

Enum.name: START_DETECTED

Enum.name: MATCHED

Enum.name: STOP_DETECTED

Enum.name: AUTOMAP
Enum.description: Auto MAP change happened last. The change may have changed this DA as well (for example, ENTDAA, and SETAASA), but at least one MAP entry automatically changed after.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Timeout disabled, if timeout is configured

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Disable open-drain stop. ODSTOP must be disabled when sending an HDR exit pattern.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Enable open-drain stop. STOP is emitted at open-drain speeds even for I3C messages. In legacy devices, this feature can ensure that the legacy devices see the STOP.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: ODHPP disabled. Open-Drain SCL High half-clock period is the same as the Open-Drain Low SCL half-period.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: ODHPP enabled. Open-Drain High SCL half-lock period is one PPBAUD count for I3C messages. This setting is faster (and works for I3C devices). Any legacy I2C devices on the bus will not see the SCL High at all (less than the spike filter period).

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Target ignores the I2C or I3C bus

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Target can operate on the I2C or I3C bus

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Always NACK enable. The target rejects all requests to it, except for a Common Command Code (CCC) broadcast. NACK = 1 should be used with caution, because the controller may decide that the target is missing, if NACK is overused.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Match START or STOP enable. START and STOP sticky SSTATUS bits only become 1 when SSTATUS[MATCHED] is 1. This setting allows START and STOP to be used to detect the end of a message to/from this target.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Ignore TE0/TE1 errors. Target does not detect TE0 or TE1 errors, so it does not lock up waiting on an Exit Pattern. This setting should only be used when the bus does not use HDR mode.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: SIDPARTNO[PARTNO] is a part number and an instance.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Enables wait to ensure the bus is not in HDR mode.

Enum.name: STOPPED
Enum.description: I3C module is in a STOP condition.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: Bus target not listening or responding.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: This bus target is listening to the bus traffic or responding.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: No CCC message is being handled.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: A CCC message is being handled automatically.

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: REQ in process is not an SDR read from this target.

Enum.name: BUSY

Enum.name: IDLE
Enum.description: REQ in process is not SDR write data from the controller.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: REQ in process is SDR write data from the controller to this bus target (or all I3C targets), but not in ENTDAA mode.

Enum.name: IN_ENTDAA
Enum.description: I3C bus is in Enter Dynamic Address Assignment (ENTDAA) mode, regardless of whether this bus target has a Dynamic Address or not.

Enum.name: NOT_IN_HDR_DDR

Enum.name: MATCHED

Enum.name: STOP_DETECTED

BitField.name: activ
BitField.description: PKC active: ACTIV=1 signals that a calculation is in progress or about to start. At the end of a calculation ACTIV is automatically reset to logic 0 in case no further GO bit is set. If the next PKC operation has been started by setting a GO bit during a calculation, ACTIV remains high. ACTIV is always '1' in case PKC_STATUS.GOANY is set. ACTIV is always '0' in case PKC_CTRL_RESET is set.

BitField.name: carry
BitField.description: Carry overflow flag: CARRY is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case

BitField.name: zero
BitField.description: Zero result flag: ZERO is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case the result of the calculation is equal zero. ZERO is updated for each PKC calculation mode, except for MUL1 (opcode 0x20) and MUL1_GF2 (opcode 0x24).

BitField.name: goany
BitField.description: Combined GO status flag: GOANY is set in case either PKC_CTRL.GOD1, GOD2, GOM1, GOM2 or GOU is set. The 1-to-0 transition of GOANY indicates that a calculation has been started and that a new GO bit can be set. If GOANY is cleared also all PKC_STATUS.LOCKED bits are cleared to indicate that the parameter set can be updated. GOANY is always '0' in case PKC_CTRL.RESET is set.

BitField.name: locked
BitField.description: Parameter set locked: Indicates if parameter set is locked due to a pending calculation start or can be overwritten.

BitField.name: reset
BitField.description: PKC reset control bit: RESET=1 enforces the PKC's reset state during which a calculation cannot be started and by which any ongoing calculation process is stopped. RESET can be set/cleared by the CPU in order to switch between PKC reset and calculation enable. RESET=1 is the default state after a chip reset.

BitField.name: stop
BitField.description: Freeze PKC calculation: STOP=1 freezes all PKC activity incl. RAM accesses and reduces the PKC power consumption to its minimum. The difference compared to the reset of the PKC is that a stopped calculation can be continued when STOP is released (reset to '0') again. The status flags are not affected by the STOP control bit.

BitField.name: god1
BitField.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 1: If GOD1 is set PKC will start a direct / L0 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1).

BitField.name: god2
BitField.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 2: If GOD2 is set PKC will start a direct / L0 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2).

BitField.name: gom1
BitField.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 1: If GOM1 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / L1 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1).

BitField.name: gom2
BitField.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 2: If GOM2 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / L1 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2).

BitField.name: gou
BitField.description: Control bit to start pipe operation: If GOU is set PKC will start the pipe / L2 operation (parameter fetch & calculation) described in section 'PKC Universal Pointer Fetch Operation'.

BitField.name: gf2conv
BitField.description: Convert to GF2 calculation modes: If GF2CONV is set operations are mapped to their GF(2) equivalent operation modes.

BitField.name: clrcache
BitField.description: Clear universal pointer cache: Invalidates the cache such that all previously fetched parameters are withdrawn and have to be fetched again via DMA accesses.

BitField.name: cache_en
BitField.description: Enable universal pointer cache: If CACHE_EN=1 the cache for the universal pointer parameters is enabled. In case a parameter value is found in the cache (from a previous fetch) no DMA access is triggered. As such the amount of DMA accesses for the parameter fetch vary between 0 and 4. To further optimize the cache utilization not used parameters, e.g. XPTR for a plain addition (opcode 0x0A), could be defined equal to a used one (e.g. equal YPTR or RPTR) or a previously fetched parameter.

BitField.name: redmul
BitField.description: Reduced multiplier mode: REDMUL defines the operand width processed by the PKC coprocessor.

Enum.name: fullsz
Enum.description: full size mode, 3 least significant bits of pointer and length are ignored, minimum supported length 0x0008

Enum.name: VALUE_64bit
Enum.description: 64-bit mode, 3 least significant bits of pointer and length are ignored, minimum supported length 0x0008

BitField.name: idleop
BitField.description: Idle operation feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: clkrnd
BitField.description: Clock randomization feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: redmulnoise
BitField.description: Noise in reduced multiplier mode feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: rnddly
BitField.description: Random delay feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: sbxnoise
BitField.description: Noise feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: alpnoise
BitField.description: Noise feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: fmulnoise
BitField.description: Noise feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

BitField.name: xptr
BitField.description: Start address of X operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: yptr
BitField.description: Start address of Y operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: zptr
BitField.description: Start address of Z operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity or constant for calculation modes using CONST:

BitField.name: rptr
BitField.description: Start address of R result in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: len
BitField.description: Operand length: LEN defines the length of the operands and the result in bytes. The length of Y, Z and R depend furthermore on the selected calculation mode.

BitField.name: mclen
BitField.description: Loop counter for microcode pattern: MCLEN defines the length of the loop counter that can be used in L1 calculation mode, e.g. in MC opcode DecrTBNZ. For the hardcoded MC patterns Modular Multiplication (MC start address 0x00), Plain Multiplication (0x13), Plain Multiplication with Addition (0x1D) and Modular Reduction (0x33) MCLEN defines the length of the X operand in bytes.

BitField.name: xptr
BitField.description: Start address of X operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: yptr
BitField.description: Start address of Y operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: zptr
BitField.description: Start address of Z operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity or constant for calculation modes using CONST:

BitField.name: rptr
BitField.description: Start address of R result in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL.REDMUL setting. Most significant bits are ignored depending on available PKCRAM size.

BitField.name: len
BitField.description: Operand length: LEN defines the length of the operands and the result in bytes. The length of Y, Z and R depend furthermore on the selected calculation mode.

BitField.name: mclen
BitField.description: Loop counter for microcode pattern: MCLEN defines the length of the loop counter that can be used in L1 calculation mode, e.g. in MC opcode DecrTBNZ. For the hardcoded MC patterns Modular Multiplication (MC start address 0x00)

BitField.name: ptr
BitField.description: Pointer to start address of PKC FUP program: PKC_UPTR needs to be defined before starting a universal pointer PKC calculation (L2) via PKC_CTRL.GOU. The pointer address needs to be valid and the memory space the pointer addresses needs to be enabled for PKC access by the system. Otherwise a security alarm is triggered (PKC_ACCESS_ERR.AHB is set).

BitField.name: ptr
BitField.description: Pointer to start address of PKC FUP table: PKC_UPTRT needs to be defined before starting a universal pointer PKC calculation (L2) via PKC_CTRL.GOU. The pointer address needs to be valid and the memory space the pointer addresses needs to be enabled for PKC access by the system. Otherwise a security alarm is triggered (PKC_ACCESS_ERR.AHB is set).

BitField.name: len
BitField.description: Length of universal pointer calculation: PKC_ULEN defines how many FUP program entries shall be processed for one L2 calculation started via PKC_CTRL.GOU. The FUP program entries include L0 calculations, L1 calculations and CRC entries for FUP program integrity protection.

BitField.name: mcdata
BitField.description: Microcode read/write data: This IP version does not support flexible MC patterns (only hard coded ones). Any read or write access to PKC_MCDATA triggers a security alarm (PKC_ACCESS_ERR.CTRL is set).

BitField.name: mulsize
BitField.description: native multiplier size and operand granularity

BitField.name: paramnum
BitField.description: Number of parameter sets for real calculation

BitField.name: mcreconf_size
BitField.description: Size of reconfigurable MC table in bytes

BitField.name: soft_rst
BitField.description: Write 1 to reset module (0 has no effect). All running and pending PKC calculation are stopped. All PKC SFRs are reset except PKC_ACCESS_ERR.

BitField.name: reserved3
BitField.description: reserved for future erors on APB I/F

BitField.name: apb_master
BitField.description: APB Master that triggered first APB error (APB_WRGMD or APB_NOTAV)

BitField.name: reserved9
BitField.description: reserved for future erors on AHB I/F L2 Only

BitField.name: ahb
BitField.description: AHB Error: invalid AHB access L2 Only

BitField.name: reserved15
BitField.description: reserved for future erors on AHB I/F L2 Only

BitField.name: fdet
BitField.description: Error due to error detection circuitry

BitField.name: en_pdone
BitField.description: Write to clear PDONE interrupt enable flag (PKC_INT_ENABLE.EN_PDONE=0).

BitField.name: en_pdone
BitField.description: Write to set PDONE interrupt enable flag (PKC_INT_ENABLE.EN_PDONE=1).

BitField.name: int_pdone
BitField.description: End-of-computation status flag: INT_PDONE is set after EACH single PKC L0 or L1 calculation. In case of a universal pointer calculation (L2) INT_PDONE is set at the end of the pipe calculation when PKC_ULEN has been decremented to zero and the final PKC calculation has completed.

BitField.name: en_pdone
BitField.description: PDONE interrupt enable flag: If EN_PDONE=1 an interrupt is triggered every time PKC_INT_STATUS.INT_PDONE is set. Otherwise the interrupt generation is suppressed.

BitField.name: int_pdone
BitField.description: Write to clear End-of-computation status flag (PKC_INT_STATUS.INT_PDONE=0).

BitField.name: int_pdone
BitField.description: Write to set End-of-computation status flag (PKC_INT_STATUS.INT_PDONE=1) to trigger a PKC interrupt via software, e.g. for debug purposes.

Enum.description: ICKBD pattern. For READ operations only, compare DOUT with inverse checkerboard data pattern for each read cycle.

Enum.description: Diagonal pattern. Used for READ operations only, compare DOUT to diagonal pattern.

Enum.name: zz235
Enum.description: Fixed data pattern. For READ operations, comparison to DOUT for selected groups; refer to R_ADR_CTRL[GRPSEL] for modules with multiple groups.

Enum.name: zz236
Enum.description: Random data pattern which will be generated based on the initial seed set in R_DATA; for READ operations, used for DOUT comparison of selected groups. For PROG operations, used to control DIN of selected groups.

Enum.name: zz237
Enum.description: DOUT based pattern. For READ operations only, DOUT of selected group will be latched in R_DATA. If more than one group is selected in R_ADR_CTRL[GRPSEL], the group with the lower index will be latched.

Enum.name: zz238
Enum.description: R_DATA based pattern. For READ operations, expected DOUT value of selected groups equals to R_DATA when XADR[0]==YADR[0] or ~R_DATA when XADR[0]!=YADR[0]. For PROG operations, DIN of selected groups equals R_DATA when XADR[0]==YADR[0] or ~R_DATA when XADR[0]!=YADR[0].

Enum.name: zz239
Enum.description: SCAN-IO pattern. For READ operations, control expected DOUT value of selected groups to SCAN-IO data pattern. For PROG operations, control DIN of selected groups to SCAN-IO data pattern.

Enum.name: zz240
Enum.description: REPAIR set. For PROG operation to IFR1(7,1) and IFR1(7,2), R_REPAIR0_0 and R_REPAIR0_1 or R_REPAIR1_0 and R_REPAIR1_1 will control DIN. For READ operation on IFR1(7,1) and IFR1(7,2), DOUT will be compared against R_REPAIR0_0 and R_REPAIR0_1 or R_REPAIR1_0 andR_REPAIR1_1. When this option is selected, only one flash block can be selected.

Enum.name: zz241
Enum.description: REPAIR load. For READ operation only, DOUT from IFR1(7,1) and IFR1(7,2) is loaded to R_REPAIR0 and R_REPAIR1.

BitField.name: NO_PRGM
BitField.description: If set, below mentioned TRNG configuration registers cannot be programmed: Oscillator 2 Control Register (OSC2_CTL): TRNG Entropy Generation Control [1:0] Oscillator 2 Divider [3:2] Oscillator Fail Safe Limit [13:12] Oscillator Fail Safe Test [14] TRNG Seed Control Register (SDCTL) TRNG Frequency Count Minimum Limit Register (FRQMIN) TRNG Frequency Count Maximum Limit Register (FRQMAX) TRNG Statistical Check Monobit Limit Register (SCML) TRNG Statistical Check Run Length 1 Limit Register (SCR1L) TRNG Statistical Check Run Length 2 Limit Register (SCR2L) TRNG Statistical Check Run Length 3 Limit Register (SCR3L) TRNG Miscellaneous Control Register (MCTL): Sample Mode [1:0] Oscillator Divider [3:2] Reset Defaults [6] Force System Clock [7] Long Runs Continuation Mode [14] After this bit has been written to a 1, it cannot be changed

Enum.name: NO_PRGM_ON

Enum.name: HW_ERR_ON
Enum.description: Enables the INT_STATUS[HW_ERR] bit to be set, thereby enabling interrupt generation for the HW_ERR condition.

Enum.name: ENT_VAL_CLEAR
Enum.description: Clears the INT_STATUS[ENT_VAL] bit. Will automatically set after writing.

Enum.name: ENT_VAL_ON
Enum.description: Enables the INT_STATUS[ENT_VAL] bit to be set, thereby enabling interrupt generation for the ENT_VAL condition.

Enum.name: FRQ_CT_FAIL_CLEAR
Enum.description: Clears the INT_STATUS[FRQ_CT_FAIL] bit. Will automatically set after writing.

Enum.name: FRQ_CT_FAIL_ON
Enum.description: Enables the INT_STATUS[FRQ_CT_FAIL] bit to be set, thereby enabling interrupt generation for the FRQ_CT_FAIL condition.

BitField.description: Read: TRNG Error. Any error in the TRNG will trigger this interrupt.

Enum.description: Controller and target, with standard feature set

Enum.description: Controller is enabled in doze mode

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Controller is disabled in doze mode

Enum.description: Controller is disabled in debug mode

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Controller is enabled in debug mode

Enum.name: NO_FLAG

Enum.description: Host request input is pin HREQ

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Host request input is input trigger

Enum.name: INPUT
Enum.description: HREQ pin is input (for LPI2C controller)

Enum.name: OUTPUT
Enum.description: HREQ pin is output (for LPI2C target)

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Received data is stored in the receive FIFO

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Received data is discarded unless the Data Match Flag (MSR[DMF]) is 1.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Abort existing transfer and do not start new transfer

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: STOP condition is automatically generated when the transmit FIFO is empty and the LPI2C controller is busy

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: LPI2C controller treats a received NACK as if it (NACK) was an ACK and the NACK Detect Flag is never written 1.

Enum.name: IF_SCL_LOW
Enum.description: MSR[PLTF] becomes 1 if SCL is low for longer than the configured timeout.

Enum.name: IF_SCL_OR_SDA_LOW
Enum.description: MSR[PLTF] becomes 1 if either SCL or SDA is low for longer than the configured timeout.

Enum.name: ANY_STOP
Enum.description: MSR[SDF] asserts on any STOP condition generated by LPI2C controller.

Enum.name: LAST_STOP
Enum.description: MSR[SDF] asserts on last STOP condition before LPI2C controller is idle (that is, the transmit FIFO is empty at the time of the STOP condition).

Enum.name: BOTH_I2C_AND_LPI2C_IDLE
Enum.description: MSR[STF] asserts on START condition provided both I2C bus and LPI2C controller are idle (that is, any non-repeated START condition initiated by any other controller on the bus but not the LPI2C controller).

Enum.name: I2C_IDLE
Enum.description: MSR[STF] asserts on START condition provided I2C bus is idle (that is, any non-repeated START condition initiated by any controller on the bus including the LPI2C controller).

Enum.name: ANY_DATA_WORD_EQUALS_MATCH0_OR_MATCH1
Enum.description: Match is enabled (any data word equals MDMR[MATCH0] OR MDMR[MATCH1])

Enum.name: FIRST_DATA_WORD_MATCH0_AND_SECOND_DATA_WORD_MATCH1
Enum.description: Match is enabled (first data word equals MDMR[MATCH0] AND second data word equals MDMR[MATCH1)

Enum.description: Match is enabled (first data word AND MDMR[MATCH1] equals MDMR[MATCH0] AND MDMR[MATCH1])

Enum.description: Match is enabled (any data word AND MDMR[MATCH1] equals MDMR[MATCH0] AND MDMR[MATCH1])

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: irqc1
Enum.description: ISF flag and DMA request on rising edge.

Enum.name: irqc2
Enum.description: ISF flag and DMA request on falling edge.

Enum.name: irqc3
Enum.description: ISF flag and DMA request on either edge.

Enum.name: irqc5
Enum.description: ISF flag sets on rising edge.

Enum.name: irqc6
Enum.description: ISF flag sets on falling edge.

Enum.name: irqc7
Enum.description: ISF flag sets on either edge.

Enum.name: irqc8
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt when logic 0.

Enum.name: irqc9
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on rising-edge.

Enum.name: irqc10
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on falling-edge.

Enum.name: irqc11
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on either edge.

Enum.name: irqc12
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt when logic 1.

Enum.name: irqc13
Enum.description: Enable active high trigger output, ISF flag on rising edge. Pin state is ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals.

Enum.name: irqc14
Enum.description: Enable active low trigger output, ISF flag on falling edge. Pin state is inverted and ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals.

Enum.name: lk0

Enum.name: lk1

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: lk0
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is not locked and can be updated.

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected on the pin of the same number. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: lk0

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: nse0
Enum.description: The pin is configured for Secure access. Read or write access to the corresponding pin's registers and bit fields is only allowed by software in Secure state. When the corresponding pin's registers are accessed by software in Non-Secure state, all bits in the registers related to that pin are read zero and write ignored.

Enum.name: lk0

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: lk0

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.description: ISF flag and DMA request on either edge.

Enum.description: ISF flag sets on rising edge.

Enum.description: ISF flag sets on falling edge.

Enum.name: irqc7
Enum.description: ISF flag sets on either edge.

Enum.name: irqc8
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt when logic 0.

Enum.name: irqc9
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on rising-edge.

Enum.name: irqc10
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on falling-edge.

Enum.name: irqc11
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt on either edge.

Enum.name: irqc12
Enum.description: ISF flag and Interrupt when logic 1.

Enum.name: irqc13
Enum.description: Enable active high trigger output, ISF flag on rising edge. Pin state is ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals.

Enum.name: irqc14
Enum.description: Enable active low trigger output, ISF flag on falling edge. Pin state is inverted and ORed with other enabled triggers to generate the output trigger, for use by other peripherals.

Enum.name: lk0
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is not locked and can be updated.

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. Enum.name: irqc14

Enum.name: lk0

Enum.name: lk1
Enum.description: Interrupt configuration by ICR[23:0] is locked and cannot be updated until next system reset.

Enum.name: isf1
Enum.description: Configured interrupt is detected. If the pin is configured to generate a DMA request, then the corresponding flag will be cleared automatically at the completion of the requested DMA transfer. Otherwise, the flag remains set until a logic 1 is written to the flag. If the pin is configured for a level sensitive interrupt and the pin remains asserted, then the flag is set again immediately after it is cleared.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: DMA hardware request signal for corresponding channel disabled

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: DMA hardware request signal for corresponding channel enabled

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Disable asynchronous DMA request for the channel

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Enable asynchronous DMA request for the channel

Enum.name: NO_ERROR
Enum.description: Error signal for corresponding channel does not generate error interrupt

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Assertion of error signal for corresponding channel generates error interrupt request

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Buffered writes on system bus disabled

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Buffered writes on system bus enabled

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was bus error on destination write

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was bus error on source read

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DLAST_SGA field

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_NBYTES or TCDn_CITER fields

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DOFF field

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DADDR field

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SOFF field

Enum.name: ERROR
Enum.description: Last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SADDR field

Enum.description: An error in this channel has not occurred

Enum.name: ERROR

Enum.name: INTERRUPT_ACTIVE
Enum.description: Interrupt request for corresponding channel active

Enum.description: Secure protection level for DMA transfers

Enum.description: Global encryption disabled. NPX on-the-fly encryption is disabled. Subsequent reads return 0.

Enum.name: ENCRYPTION_ENABLED
Enum.description: Global encryption enabled. NPX on-the-fly encryption is enabled if the flash access hits in a valid memory context. Subsequent reads return 1.

Enum.name: DECRYPTION_DISABLED
Enum.description: Global decryption disabled. NPX on-the-fly decryption is globally disabled. Subsequent reads return 0.

Enum.name: DECRYPTION_ENABLED
Enum.description: Global decryption enabled. NPX on-the-fly decryption is globally enabled. Subsequent reads return 1.

Enum.name: LOCK_ENABLED
Enum.description: Lock enabled: cannot write to VMAPCTXn, NPXCR, or CACMSK. Subsequent reads return 1.

Enum.name: LOCK_ENABLED
Enum.description: Lock enabled: cannot write to mask. Subsequent reads return 1.

Enum.name: LOCK_ENABLED

Enum.name: LOCK_DISABLED
Enum.description: Lock disabled: can write to REMAP

Enum.name: IPBUS
Enum.description: The IPBus clock is used as the clock for the local prescaler and counter.

Enum.name: EXT_CLK
Enum.description: EXT_CLK is used as the clock for the local prescaler and counter.

Enum.name: AUX_CLK
Enum.description: Submodule 0's clock (AUX_CLK) is used as the source clock for the local prescaler and counter. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it forces the clock to logic 0.

Enum.name: LOCAL
Enum.description: The local RELOAD signal is used to reload registers.

Enum.name: MASTER
Enum.description: The master RELOAD signal (from submodule 0) is used to reload registers. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it forces the RELOAD signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: LOCAL
Enum.description: The local force signal, CTRL2[FORCE], from this submodule is used to force updates.

Enum.name: MASTER
Enum.description: The master force signal from submodule 0 is used to force updates. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it holds the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: LOCAL_RELOAD
Enum.description: The local reload signal from this submodule is used to force updates without regard to the state of LDOK.

Enum.name: MASTER_RELOAD
Enum.description: The master reload signal from submodule0 is used to force updates if LDOK is set. This setting should not be used in submodule0 as it holds the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: LOCAL_SYNC
Enum.description: The local sync signal from this submodule is used to force updates.

Enum.name: MASTER_SYNC
Enum.description: The master sync signal from submodule0 is used to force updates. This setting should not be used in submodule0 as it holds the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: EXT_FORCE
Enum.description: The external force signal, EXT_FORCE, from outside the PWM module causes updates.

Enum.name: EXT_SYNC
Enum.description: The external sync signal, EXT_SYNC, from outside the PWM module causes updates.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Initialization from a FORCE_OUT is disabled.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Initialization from a FORCE_OUT is enabled.

Enum.name: MASTER_RELOAD
Enum.description: Master reload from submodule 0 causes initialization. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it forces the INIT signal to logic 0. The submodule counter will only re-initialize when a master reload occurs.

Enum.name: MASTER_SYNC
Enum.description: Master sync from submodule 0 causes initialization. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it forces the INIT signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: COMPLEMENTARY
Enum.description: PWM_A and PWM_B form a complementary PWM pair.

Enum.name: INDEPENDENT
Enum.description: PWM_A and PWM_B outputs are independent PWMs.

Enum.name: NEXT_PWM_RELOAD
Enum.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect at the next PWM reload if MCTRL[LDOK] is set.

Enum.name: MTCTRL_LDOK_SET
Enum.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect immediately upon MCTRL[LDOK] being set. In this case, it is not necessary to set CTRL[FULL] or CTRL[HALF].

BitField.name: SPLIT
BitField.description: Split the DBLPWM signal to PWM_A and PWM_B

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWM_A and PWM_B each have double pulses.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Stretch count is zero, no stretch.

Enum.name: NORMAL
Enum.description: Normal mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFPINx]. If neither FHALF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. The PWM outputs disabled by this fault input will not be re-enabled until the actual FAULTx input signal de-asserts since the fault input will combinationally disable the PWM outputs (as programmed in DISMAPn).

Enum.name: SAFE
Enum.description: Safe mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear and FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FHLAF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

Enum.name: MANUAL
Enum.description: Manual fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. This is further controlled by FCTRL[FSAFE].

Enum.name: AUTOMATIC
Enum.description: Automatic fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are enabled when FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFLAGx]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

Enum.name: LOGIC_0
Enum.description: A logic 0 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

Enum.name: LOGIC_1
Enum.description: A logic 1 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

Enum.name: NO_FLAG
Enum.description: No fault on the FAULTx pin.

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED
Enum.description: PWM outputs are not re-enabled at the start of a full cycle

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Fault input glitch stretching is disabled.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Input fault signals are stretched to at least 2 IPBus clock cycles.

BitField.name: NOCOMB
BitField.description: No Combinational Path From Fault Input To PWM Output

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: There is a combinational link from the fault inputs to the PWM outputs. The fault inputs are combined with the filtered and latched fault signals to disable the PWM outputs.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: The direct combinational path from the fault inputs to the PWM outputs is disabled and the filtered and latched fault signals are used to disable the PWM outputs.

Enum.name: IPBUS
Enum.description: The IPBus clock is used as the clock for the local prescaler and counter.

Enum.name: AUX_CLK

Enum.name: MASTER

Enum.name: LOCAL

Enum.name: MASTER

Enum.name: LOCAL_RELOAD

Enum.name: MASTER_RELOAD

Enum.name: LOCAL_SYNC

Enum.name: MASTER_SYNC

BitField.name: SPLIT
BitField.description: Split the DBLPWM signal to PWM_A and PWM_B

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWM_A and PWM_B each have double pulses.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

Enum.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

Enum.name: LOCAL
Enum.description: The local force signal, CTRL2[FORCE], from this submodule is used to force updates.

Enum.name: MASTER
Enum.description: The master force signal from submodule 0 is used to force updates. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it holds the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

Enum.name: MASTER_RELOAD

Enum.name: MASTER_SYNC

Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.name: MASTER_RELOAD
Enum.description: Master reload from submodule 0 causes initialization. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it forces the INIT signal to logic 0. The submodule counter will only re-initialize when a master reload occurs.

Enum.name: INDEPENDENT
Enum.description: PWM_A and PWM_B outputs are independent PWMs.

Enum.name: NEXT_PWM_RELOAD
Enum.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect at the next PWM reload if MCTRL[LDOK] is set.

Enum.name: MTCTRL_LDOK_SET
Enum.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect immediately upon MCTRL[LDOK] being set. In this case, it is not necessary to set CTRL[FULL] or CTRL[HALF].

BitField.name: SPLIT
BitField.description: Split the DBLPWM signal to PWM_A and PWM_B

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWM_A and PWM_B each have double pulses.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

Enum.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
Enum.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

Enum.description: Disable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

BitField.name: STRETCH_CNT_PRSC
BitField.description: Stretch IPBus clock count prescaler for mux0_trig/mux1_trig/out0_trig/out1_trig/pwma_trig/pwmb_trig

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Stretch count is zero, no stretch.

Enum.name: NORMAL
Enum.description: Normal mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFPINx]. If neither FHALF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. The PWM outputs disabled by this fault input will not be re-enabled until the actual FAULTx input signal de-asserts since the fault input will combinationally disable the PWM outputs (as programmed in DISMAPn).

Enum.name: SAFE
Enum.description: Safe mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear and FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FHLAF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

Enum.name: MANUAL
Enum.description: Manual fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. This is further controlled by FCTRL[FSAFE].

Enum.name: AUTOMATIC
Enum.description: Automatic fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are enabled when FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFLAGx]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

Enum.name: LOGIC_0
Enum.description: A logic 0 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

Enum.name: LOGIC_1
Enum.description: A logic 1 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

Enum.name: NO_FLAG
Enum.description: No fault on the FAULTx pin.

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED
Enum.description: PWM outputs are not re-enabled at the start of a full cycle

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
Enum.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a full cycle

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED
Enum.description: PWM outputs are not re-enabled at the start of a half cycle.

Enum.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
Enum.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a half cycle (as defined by VAL0).

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Fault input glitch stretching is disabled.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Input fault signals are stretched to at least 2 IPBus clock cycles.

BitField.name: NOCOMB
BitField.description: No Combinational Path From Fault Input To PWM Output

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: There is a combinational link from the fault inputs to the PWM outputs. The fault inputs are combined with the filtered and latched fault signals to disable the PWM outputs.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: The direct combinational path from the fault inputs to the PWM outputs is disabled and the filtered and latched fault signals are used to disable the PWM outputs.

Enum.name: USE
Enum.description: Uses the standard quadrature decoder, where PHASEA and PHASEB represent a two-phase quadrature signal.

Enum.name: BYPASS
Enum.description: Bypasses the quadrature decoder. A positive transition of the PHASEA input generates a count signal. PHASEB input and CTRL[REV] controls the counter direction. If the value of CTRL[REV] and PHASEB are identical; then count is up. If the value of CTRL[REV] and PHASEB is different, then count is down.

BitField.name: HNE

Enum.name: NEG
Enum.description: Use negative-going edge-to-trigger initialization of position counters UPOS and LPOS

BitField.name: HIP

Enum.name: HOME

BitField.name: XIP
BitField.description: INDEX Triggered Initialization of Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

Enum.name: USE
Enum.description: Uses the standard quadrature decoder, where PHASEA and PHASEB represent a two-phase quadrature signal.

Enum.name: BYPASS
Enum.description: Bypasses the quadrature decoder. A positive transition of the PHASEA input generates a count signal. PHASEB input and CTRL[REV] controls the counter direction. If the value of CTRL[REV] and PHASEB are identical; then count is up. If the value of CTRL[REV] and PHASEB is different, then count is down.

BitField.name: SWIP
BitField.description: Software-Triggered Initialization of Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

BitField.name: HNE
BitField.description: Use Negative Edge of HOME Input

Enum.name: POS
Enum.description: Use positive-going edge-to-trigger initialization of position counters UPOS and LPOS

Enum.name: NEG
Enum.description: Use negative-going edge-to-trigger initialization of position counters UPOS and LPOS

BitField.name: HIP
BitField.description: Enable HOME to Initialize Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

Enum.name: HOME
Enum.description: HOME signal initializes the position counter

BitField.name: FILT_PRSC
BitField.description: Prescaler Divide IPBus Clock to FILT Clock

Enum.name: COUNT
Enum.description: Use modulus counting roll-over or roll-under

Enum.name: COMPARE
Enum.description: POSMATCH pulses when a match occurs between the position counters (POS) and the corresponding compare value (COMP )

Enum.name: READ
Enum.description: POSMATCH pulses when the UPOS, LPOS, REV, or POSD registers are read

BitField.name: SABIE
BitField.description: Simultaneous PHASEA and PHASEB Change Interrupt Enable

BitField.name: SABIRQ
BitField.description: Simultaneous PHASEA and PHASEB Change Interrupt Request

BitField.name: MAXMB
BitField.description: Number Of The Last Message Buffer

Enum.name: one_full_ID
Enum.description: Format A: One full ID (standard and extended) per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: two_full_ID
Enum.description: Format B: Two full standard IDs or two partial 14-bit (standard and extended) IDs per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: four_partial_ID
Enum.description: Format C: Four partial 8-bit standard IDs per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: CAN_FD_disabled
Enum.description: CAN FD is disabled. FlexCAN is able to receive and transmit messages in CAN 2.0 format.

Enum.name: CAN_FD_enabled
Enum.description: CAN FD is enabled. FlexCAN is able to receive and transmit messages in both CAN FD and CAN 2.0 formats.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: DMA feature for Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO disabled.

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: DMA feature for Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO enabled.

BitField.name: IRMQ
BitField.description: Individual Rx Masking And Queue Enable

Enum.name: individual_rx_masking_disabled
Enum.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are disabled. For backward compatibility with legacy applications, the reading of C/S word locks the MB even if it is EMPTY.

Enum.name: individual_rx_masking_enabled
Enum.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are enabled.

Enum.name: unfiltered_rx_input
Enum.description: FlexCAN uses the unfiltered Rx input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: filtered_rx_input
Enum.description: FlexCAN uses the filtered Rx input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: low_power_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not in a low-power mode.

Enum.name: low_power_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN is in a low-power mode.

Enum.name: TWRNINT_RWRNINT_inactive
Enum.description: TWRNINT and RWRNINT bits are zero, independent of the values in the error counters.

Enum.name: TWRNINT_RWRNINT_active
Enum.description: TWRNINT and RWRNINT bits are set when the respective error counter transitions from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: self_wakeup_disabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN Self Wake Up feature is disabled.

Enum.name: self_wakeup_enabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN Self Wake Up feature is enabled.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN not in Freeze mode, prescaler running.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN in Freeze mode, prescaler stopped.

Enum.name: SOFTRST_reset_registers
Enum.description: Resets the registers affected by soft reset.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: FlexCAN module is either in Normal mode, Listen-Only mode, or Loop-Back mode.

Enum.name: id4
Enum.description: FlexCAN module is either in Disable mode, Stop mode, or Freeze mode.

Enum.name: HALT_enable
Enum.description: Enters Freeze mode if the FRZ bit is asserted.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_disabled
Enum.description: Not enabled to enter Freeze mode.

Enum.name: listen_only_mode_enabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN module operates in Listen-Only mode.

Enum.name: highest_buffer_first
Enum.description: Buffer with highest priority is transmitted first.

Enum.name: lowest_buffer_first
Enum.description: Lowest number buffer is transmitted first.

Enum.name: auto_recover_enabled
Enum.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state enabled.

Enum.name: auto_recover_disabled
Enum.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state disabled.

Enum.name: one_sample
Enum.description: Just one sample is used to determine the bit value.

Enum.name: three_sample
Enum.description: Three samples are used to determine the value of the received bit: the regular one (sample point) and two preceding samples; a majority rule is used.

BitField.name: TXERRCNT_FAST
BitField.description: Transmit Error Counter for fast bits

BitField.name: RXERRCNT_FAST
BitField.description: Receive Error Counter for fast bits

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Indicates a recessive to dominant transition was received on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Indicates setting of any error bit in the Error and Status register.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: FlexCAN module entered Bus Off state.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not receiving a message.

Enum.name: transmit_message_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not transmitting a message.

Enum.name: RXERRCNT_GTE_96
Enum.description: RXERRCNT is greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: TXERRCNT_GTE_96
Enum.description: TXERRCNT is greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: stuffing_error_yes
Enum.description: A stuffing error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: form_error_yes
Enum.description: A Form Error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: CRC_error_yes
Enum.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: ACK_error_yes
Enum.description: An ACK error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: bit0_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive.

Enum.name: bit1_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant.

Enum.name: Rx_warning_int_yes
Enum.description: The Rx error counter transitioned from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: Tx_warning_int_yes
Enum.description: The Tx error counter transitioned from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: CAN_bus_sync_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not synchronized to the CAN bus.

Enum.name: CAN_bus_sync_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN is synchronized to the CAN bus.

Enum.name: bus_off_done
Enum.description: FlexCAN module has completed Bus Off process.

BitField.name: ERRINT_FAST
BitField.description: Error interrupt for errors detected in Data Phase of CAN FD frames with BRS bit set

Enum.name: errors_data_phase_yes
Enum.description: Indicates setting of any error bit detected in the data phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set.

BitField.name: STFERR_FAST
BitField.description: Stuffing Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: stuffing_error_yes
Enum.description: A stuffing error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: FRMERR_FAST
BitField.description: Form Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: form_error_yes
Enum.description: A form error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: CRCERR_FAST
BitField.description: Cyclic Redundancy Check Error in the CRC field of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: CRC_error_yes
Enum.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: BIT0ERR_FAST
BitField.description: Bit0 Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: bit0_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive.

BitField.name: BIT1ERR_FAST
BitField.description: Bit1 Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: bit1_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant.

BitField.name: BUF0I
BitField.description: Buffer MB0 Interrupt Or Clear Legacy FIFO bit

Enum.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_not_complete
Enum.description: The corresponding buffer has no occurrence of successfully completed transmission or reception when MCR[RFEN]=0.

Enum.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_complete
Enum.description: The corresponding buffer has successfully completed transmission or reception when MCR[RFEN]=0.

BitField.name: BUF5I
BitField.description: Buffer MB5 Interrupt Or Frames available in Legacy Rx FIFO

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB5 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of frame(s) available in the Legacy FIFO, when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB5 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or frame(s) available in the Legacy Rx FIFO when MCR[RFEN]=1. It generates a DMA request in case of MCR[RFEN] and MCR[DMA] are enabled.

BitField.name: BUF6I
BitField.description: Buffer MB6 Interrupt Or Legacy Rx FIFO Warning

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB6 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of Legacy Rx FIFO almost full when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB6 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or Legacy Rx FIFO almost full when MCR[RFEN]=1

BitField.name: BUF7I
BitField.description: Buffer MB7 Interrupt Or Legacy Rx FIFO Overflow

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB7 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of Legacy Rx FIFO overflow when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB7 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or Legacy Rx FIFO overflow when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: non_ISO
Enum.description: FlexCAN operates using the non-ISO CAN FD protocol.

Enum.name: ISO
Enum.description: FlexCAN operates using the ISO CAN FD protocol (ISO 11898-1:2015).

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: CAN Bit timing expansion is disabled.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: CAN bit timing expansion is enabled.

BitField.name: EACEN
BitField.description: Entire Frame Arbitration Field Comparison Enable For Rx Mailboxes

Enum.name: RTR_compare_no
Enum.description: Rx mailbox filter's IDE bit is always compared and RTR is never compared despite mask bits.

Enum.name: RTR_compare_yes
Enum.description: Enables the comparison of both Rx mailbox filter's IDE and RTR bit with their corresponding bits within the incoming frame. Mask bits do apply.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: Matching starts from Legacy Rx FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO and continues on mailboxes.

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: Matching starts from mailboxes and continues on Legacy Rx FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO.

BitField.name: RFFN
BitField.description: Number Of Legacy Rx FIFO Filters

BitField.name: ERRMSK_FAST
BitField.description: Error Interrupt Mask for errors detected in the data phase of fast CAN FD frames

Enum.name: inactive_mailbox_no
Enum.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, the ESR2[LPTM] is not an inactive mailbox.

Enum.name: inactive_mailbox_yes
Enum.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, there is at least one inactive mailbox. LPTM content is the number of the first one.

Enum.name: invalid
Enum.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are invalid.

Enum.name: valid
Enum.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are valid.

Register.name: RXFGMASK
Register.description: Legacy Rx FIFO Global Mask Register

BitField.name: FGM
BitField.description: Legacy Rx FIFO Global Mask Bits

BitField.name: TIME_STAMP
BitField.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: TIME_STAMP
BitField.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: TIME_STAMP
BitField.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.
