Enum.description: Enhanced Rx FIFO Underflow interrupt is enabled

Enum.name: not_full
Enum.description: Enhanced Rx FIFO is not full

Enum.name: not_empty
Enum.description: Enhanced Rx FIFO is not empty

Enum.name: message_stored
Enum.description: There is at least one message stored in Enhanced Rx FIFO

Enum.name: watermark_yes
Enum.description: The number of messages in FIFO is greater than the watermark

BitField.name: MAXMB
BitField.description: Number Of The Last Message Buffer

Enum.name: one_full_ID
Enum.description: Format A: One full ID (standard and extended) per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: two_full_ID
Enum.description: Format B: Two full standard IDs or two partial 14-bit (standard and extended) IDs per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: four_partial_ID
Enum.description: Format C: Four partial 8-bit standard IDs per ID filter table element.

Enum.name: CAN_FD_disabled
Enum.description: CAN FD is disabled. FlexCAN is able to receive and transmit messages in CAN 2.0 format.

Enum.name: CAN_FD_enabled
Enum.description: CAN FD is enabled. FlexCAN is able to receive and transmit messages in both CAN FD and CAN 2.0 formats.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: DMA feature for Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO disabled.

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: DMA feature for Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO enabled.

BitField.name: IRMQ
BitField.description: Individual Rx Masking And Queue Enable

Enum.name: individual_rx_masking_disabled
Enum.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are disabled. For backward compatibility with legacy applications, the reading of C/S word locks the MB even if it is EMPTY.

Enum.name: individual_rx_masking_enabled
Enum.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are enabled.

Enum.name: unfiltered_rx_input
Enum.description: FlexCAN uses the unfiltered Rx input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: filtered_rx_input
Enum.description: FlexCAN uses the filtered Rx input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: low_power_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not in a low-power mode.

Enum.name: low_power_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN is in a low-power mode.

Enum.name: TWRNINT_RWRNINT_inactive
Enum.description: TWRNINT and RWRNINT bits are zero, independent of the values in the error counters.

Enum.name: TWRNINT_RWRNINT_active
Enum.description: TWRNINT and RWRNINT bits are set when the respective error counter transitions from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: self_wakeup_disabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN Self Wake Up feature is disabled.

Enum.name: self_wakeup_enabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN Self Wake Up feature is enabled.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN not in Freeze mode, prescaler running.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN in Freeze mode, prescaler stopped.

Enum.name: SOFTRST_reset_registers
Enum.description: Resets the registers affected by soft reset.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: FlexCAN module is either in Normal mode, Listen-Only mode, or Loop-Back mode.

Enum.name: id4
Enum.description: FlexCAN module is either in Disable mode, Stop mode, or Freeze mode.

Enum.name: HALT_enable
Enum.description: Enters Freeze mode if the FRZ bit is asserted.

Enum.name: freeze_mode_disabled
Enum.description: Not enabled to enter Freeze mode.

Enum.name: listen_only_mode_enabled
Enum.description: FlexCAN module operates in Listen-Only mode.

Enum.name: highest_buffer_first
Enum.description: Buffer with highest priority is transmitted first.

Enum.name: lowest_buffer_first
Enum.description: Lowest number buffer is transmitted first.

Enum.name: auto_recover_enabled
Enum.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state enabled.

Enum.name: auto_recover_disabled
Enum.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state disabled.

Enum.name: one_sample
Enum.description: Just one sample is used to determine the bit value.

Enum.name: three_sample
Enum.description: Three samples are used to determine the value of the received bit: the regular one (sample point) and two preceding samples; a majority rule is used.

BitField.name: TXERRCNT_FAST
BitField.description: Transmit Error Counter for fast bits

BitField.name: RXERRCNT_FAST
BitField.description: Receive Error Counter for fast bits

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Indicates a recessive to dominant transition was received on the CAN bus.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Indicates setting of any error bit in the Error and Status register.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: FlexCAN module entered Bus Off state.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not receiving a message.

Enum.name: transmit_message_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not transmitting a message.

Enum.name: RXERRCNT_GTE_96
Enum.description: RXERRCNT is greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: TXERRCNT_GTE_96
Enum.description: TXERRCNT is greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: stuffing_error_yes
Enum.description: A stuffing error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: form_error_yes
Enum.description: A Form Error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: CRC_error_yes
Enum.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: ACK_error_yes
Enum.description: An ACK error occurred since last read of this register.

Enum.name: bit0_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive.

Enum.name: bit1_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant.

Enum.name: Rx_warning_int_yes
Enum.description: The Rx error counter transitioned from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: Tx_warning_int_yes
Enum.description: The Tx error counter transitioned from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

Enum.name: CAN_bus_sync_no
Enum.description: FlexCAN is not synchronized to the CAN bus.

Enum.name: CAN_bus_sync_yes
Enum.description: FlexCAN is synchronized to the CAN bus.

Enum.name: bus_off_done
Enum.description: FlexCAN module has completed Bus Off process.

BitField.name: ERRINT_FAST
BitField.description: Error interrupt for errors detected in Data Phase of CAN FD frames with BRS bit set

Enum.name: errors_data_phase_yes
Enum.description: Indicates setting of any error bit detected in the data phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set.

BitField.name: STFERR_FAST
BitField.description: Stuffing Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: stuffing_error_yes
Enum.description: A stuffing error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: FRMERR_FAST
BitField.description: Form Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: form_error_yes
Enum.description: A form error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: CRCERR_FAST
BitField.description: Cyclic Redundancy Check Error in the CRC field of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: CRC_error_yes
Enum.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

BitField.name: BIT0ERR_FAST
BitField.description: Bit0 Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: bit0_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive.

BitField.name: BIT1ERR_FAST
BitField.description: Bit1 Error in the Data Phase of CAN FD frames with the BRS bit set

Enum.name: bit1_error_yes
Enum.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant.

BitField.name: BUF0I
BitField.description: Buffer MB0 Interrupt Or Clear Legacy FIFO bit

Enum.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_not_complete
Enum.description: The corresponding buffer has no occurrence of successfully completed transmission or reception when MCR[RFEN]=0.

Enum.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_complete
Enum.description: The corresponding buffer has successfully completed transmission or reception when MCR[RFEN]=0.

BitField.name: BUF5I
BitField.description: Buffer MB5 Interrupt Or Frames available in Legacy Rx FIFO

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB5 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of frame(s) available in the Legacy FIFO, when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB5 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or frame(s) available in the Legacy Rx FIFO when MCR[RFEN]=1. It generates a DMA request in case of MCR[RFEN] and MCR[DMA] are enabled.

BitField.name: BUF6I
BitField.description: Buffer MB6 Interrupt Or Legacy Rx FIFO Warning

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB6 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of Legacy Rx FIFO almost full when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB6 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or Legacy Rx FIFO almost full when MCR[RFEN]=1

BitField.name: BUF7I
BitField.description: Buffer MB7 Interrupt Or Legacy Rx FIFO Overflow

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: No occurrence of MB7 completing transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or of Legacy Rx FIFO overflow when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: MB7 completed transmission/reception when MCR[RFEN]=0, or Legacy Rx FIFO overflow when MCR[RFEN]=1

Enum.name: non_ISO
Enum.description: FlexCAN operates using the non-ISO CAN FD protocol.

Enum.name: ISO
Enum.description: FlexCAN operates using the ISO CAN FD protocol (ISO 11898-1:2015).

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: CAN Bit timing expansion is disabled.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: CAN bit timing expansion is enabled.

BitField.name: EACEN
BitField.description: Entire Frame Arbitration Field Comparison Enable For Rx Mailboxes

Enum.name: RTR_compare_no
Enum.description: Rx mailbox filter's IDE bit is always compared and RTR is never compared despite mask bits.

Enum.name: RTR_compare_yes
Enum.description: Enables the comparison of both Rx mailbox filter's IDE and RTR bit with their corresponding bits within the incoming frame. Mask bits do apply.

Enum.name: id1
Enum.description: Matching starts from Legacy Rx FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO and continues on mailboxes.

Enum.name: id3
Enum.description: Matching starts from mailboxes and continues on Legacy Rx FIFO or Enhanced Rx FIFO.

BitField.name: RFFN
BitField.description: Number Of Legacy Rx FIFO Filters

BitField.name: ERRMSK_FAST
BitField.description: Error Interrupt Mask for errors detected in the data phase of fast CAN FD frames

Enum.name: inactive_mailbox_no
Enum.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, the ESR2[LPTM] is not an inactive mailbox.

Enum.name: inactive_mailbox_yes
Enum.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, there is at least one inactive mailbox. LPTM content is the number of the first one.

Enum.name: invalid
Enum.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are invalid.

Enum.name: valid
Enum.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are valid.

Register.name: RXFGMASK

BitField.name: FGM
BitField.description: Legacy Rx FIFO Global Mask Bits

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: TIME_STAMP
BitField.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

BitField.name: ESI
BitField.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: BRS
BitField.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

BitField.name: EDL
BitField.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

BitField.name: EXT
BitField.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: STD
BitField.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

BitField.name: PRIO
BitField.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

BitField.name: TIME_STAMP
BitField.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

BitField.name: DLC
BitField.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

BitField.name: RTR
BitField.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

BitField.name: IDE
BitField.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

BitField.name: SRR
BitField.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

BitField.name: CODE
BitField.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

Enum.name: ID_payload_filtering
Enum.description: Message ID filtering and payload filtering

Enum.name: ID_filtering_number
Enum.description: Message ID filtering occurring a specified number of times

Enum.name: ID_payload_filtering_number
Enum.description: Message ID filtering and payload filtering a specified number of times

Enum.name: match_exact
Enum.description: Match upon ID contents against an exact target value

Enum.name: match_GTE
Enum.description: Match upon an ID value greater than or equal to a specified target value

Enum.name: match_LTE
Enum.description: Match upon an ID value smaller than or equal to a specified target value

Enum.name: match_range
Enum.description: Match upon an ID value inside a range, greater than or equal to a specified lower limit, and smaller than or equal to a specified upper limit

Enum.name: match_exact
Enum.description: Match upon a payload contents against an exact target value

Enum.name: match_GTE
Enum.description: Match upon a payload value greater than or equal to a specified target value

Enum.name: match_LTE
Enum.description: Match upon a payload value smaller than or equal to a specified target value

Enum.name: match_range
Enum.description: Match upon a payload value inside a range, greater than or equal to a specified lower limit, and smaller than or equal to a specified upper limit

BitField.name: NMATCH
BitField.description: Number of Messages Matching the Same Filtering Criteria

Enum.name: match_1
Enum.description: Received message must match the predefined filtering criteria for ID and/or PL once before generating a wakeup event.

Enum.name: match_2
Enum.description: Received message must match the predefined filtering criteria for ID and/or PL twice before generating a wakeup event.

Enum.name: match_255
Enum.description: Received message must match the predefined filtering criteria for ID and/or PL 255 times before generating a wakeup event.

Enum.description: No wakeup by timeout event detected

Enum.name: value11
Enum.description: Transmitter outputs stop bit value 1 on store. If stop bit is not 1, receiver/match store sets error flag. When timer is in stop condition, receiver/match store also stores receive data on the configured shift edge.

Enum.name: EXCEPTION_DETECTED
Enum.description: A trigger exception has occurred and is pending acknowledgment.

Enum.name: FLAG_CLEAR
Enum.description: Either IE[TCOMP_IE] = 0, or no trigger sequences have run to completion.

Enum.name: COMPLETION_DETECTED
Enum.description: Trigger sequence has been completed and all data is stored in the associated FIFO.

Enum.name: NOT_SET
Enum.description: Calibration is incomplete or has not been run.

Enum.name: NOT_ACTIVE
Enum.description: ADC is idle. There are no pending triggers to service and no active commands are being processed.

Enum.name: BUSY
Enum.description: ADC is processing a conversion, running through the power-up delay, or servicing a trigger.

Enum.name: ABORT_CURRENT_ON_PRIORITY
Enum.description: Current conversion is aborted and the new command specified by the trigger is started.

Enum.name: FINISH_CURRENT_ON_PRIORITY
Enum.description: Current command is stopped after completing the current conversion. If averaging is enabled, the averaging loop is completed. CMDHn[LOOP] is ignored and the higher-priority trigger is serviced.

Enum.name: FINISH_SEQUENCE_ON_PRIORITY
Enum.description: Current command is completed (averaging, looping, compare) before servicing the higher-priority trigger.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Trigger sequence resumed from the command that was executed prior to the exception.

Enum.name: NOT_PRE_ENABLED
Enum.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Analog startup delays affect performance.

Enum.name: PRE_ENABLED
Enum.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays, at the cost of higher DC current consumption. A single power-up delay (CFG[PUDLY]) is executed immediately once PWREN is set. No detected triggers begin ADC operation until the power-up delay time has passed. After this initial delay expires, the analog circuits remain pre-enabled, and no additional delays are executed.

Enum.name: LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

Enum.name: NOT_LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: NO_ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

Enum.name: ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

Enum.name: AHBTM
Enum.description: Master strict mode is on and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level.

Enum.name: AHBSM1
Enum.description: Master strict mode is disabled and can access memories and peripherals at same level only

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

Enum.name: LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

Enum.name: NOT_LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: NO_ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

Enum.name: ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

Enum.name: AHBTM
Enum.description: Master strict mode is on and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level.

Enum.name: AHBSM1
Enum.description: Master strict mode is disabled and can access memories and peripherals at same level only

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

Enum.name: LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

Enum.name: NOT_LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

Enum.name: ENABLED

Enum.name: DISABLED

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables privilege checking of non-secure mode access is disabled.

Enum.name: NO_ABORT

Enum.name: ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

Enum.description: Master strict mode is on and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level

Enum.name: LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

Enum.name: NOT_LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

Enum.name: LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

Enum.name: NOT_LOCKED
Enum.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

Enum.name: ENABLED
Enum.description: Enables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: Disables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

Enum.name: NO_ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

Enum.name: ABORT
Enum.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

Enum.name: AHBTM
Enum.description: Master strict mode is on and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level.

Enum.name: AHBSM1
Enum.description: Master strict mode is disabled and can access memories and peripherals at same level only

Enum.name: DISABLED
Enum.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

BitField.name: INTID
BitField.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-479.

Register.name: AIRCR
Register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

BitField.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
BitField.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

BitField.name: SYSRESETREQ
BitField.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

Enum.name: NO_REQUEST
Enum.description: Do not request a system reset.

BitField.name: SYSRESETREQS
BitField.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

Enum.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
Enum.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

Enum.name: SECURE_ONLY
Enum.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

BitField.name: PRIGROUP
BitField.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

BitField.name: BFHFNMINS
BitField.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

Enum.name: SECURE
Enum.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

Enum.name: NON_SECURE
Enum.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

BitField.name: PRIS
BitField.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

Enum.name: SAME_PRIORITY
Enum.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

BitField.name: ENDIANNESS
BitField.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

BitField.name: VECTKEY
BitField.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

Register.name: SCR
Register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

BitField.name: SLEEPONEXIT
BitField.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

Enum.name: NOT_SLEEP
Enum.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

Enum.name: SLEEP
Enum.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

BitField.name: SLEEPDEEP
BitField.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

BitField.name: SLEEPDEEPS
BitField.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

Enum.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
Enum.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

Enum.name: SECURE_ONLY
Enum.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

BitField.name: SEVONPEND
BitField.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

Enum.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
Enum.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

Enum.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
Enum.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor

Register.name: SHCSR
Register.description: System Handler Control and State Register

Enum.name: NOT_ACTIVE
Enum.description: Debug monitor exception is not active.

Enum.name: NOT_PERMITTED
Enum.description: Non-secure accesses to this coprocessor generate a NOCP UsageFault.

Enum.name: PERMITTED
Enum.description: Non-secure access to this coprocessor permitted.

Enum.name: NOT_PERMITTED
Enum.description: Non-secure accesses to this coprocessor generate a NOCP UsageFault.

Enum.name: PERMITTED
Enum.description: Non-secure access to this coprocessor permitted.

Register.name: TYPE
Register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.

BitField.name: SEPARATE
BitField.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv8-M only supports a unified MPU

BitField.name: DREGION
BitField.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.

BitField.name: HFNMIENA
BitField.description: Enables the operation of MPU during HardFault and NMI handlers

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: MPU is disabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: The MPU is enabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

Enum.name: ENABLE
Enum.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.

Enum.name: DISABLE
Enum.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged accesses.

BitField.name: REGION
BitField.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

BitField.name: XN
BitField.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

Enum.name: EXECUTE
Enum.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

BitField.name: AP
BitField.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

BitField.name: SH
BitField.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

BitField.name: BASE
BitField.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

BitField.name: ATTRINDX
BitField.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

BitField.name: LIMIT
BitField.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

BitField.name: XN
BitField.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

BitField.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

BitField.name: LIMIT
BitField.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

BitField.name: ATTR0
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 0.

BitField.name: ATTR1
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 1.

BitField.name: ATTR2
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 2.

BitField.name: ATTR3
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 3.

BitField.name: ATTR4
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 4.

BitField.name: ATTR5
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 5.

BitField.name: ATTR6
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 6.

BitField.name: ATTR7
BitField.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 7.

BitField.name: ENABLE
BitField.description: Enable. Enables the SAU. This bit is RAZ/WI when the Security Extension is implemented without an SAU region.

Enum.name: SECURED_MEMORY
Enum.description: Memory is marked as Secure and is not Non-secure callable.

BitField.name: SREGION
BitField.description: SAU regions. The number of implemented SAU regions.

Register.name: RNR
Register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Number Register

Register.name: RBAR
Register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Base Address Register

BitField.name: BADDR
BitField.description: Base address. Holds bits[31:5] of the base address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the base address are defined as 0x00.

Register.name: RLAR
Register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Limit Address Register

BitField.name: NSC
BitField.description: Non-secure callable. Controls whether Non-secure state is permitted to execute an SG instruction from this region.

BitField.name: LADDR
BitField.description: Limit address. Holds bits[31:5] of the limit address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the limit address are defined as 0x1F.

BitField.name: ADDRESS
BitField.description: When the SFARVALID bit of the SFSR is set to 1, this field holds the address of an access that caused an SAU violation.

BitField.name: RELOAD
BitField.description: Value to load into the SYST_CVR when the counter is enabled and when it reaches 0

BitField.name: CURRENT
BitField.description: The current value of the SysTick counter

BitField.name: TENMS
BitField.description: Reload value for 10ms (100Hz) timing, subject to system clock skew errors

BitField.name: SKEW
BitField.description: Indicates whether the TENMS value is exact

BitField.name: NOREF
BitField.description: Indicates whether the device provides a reference clock to the processor
